name: Zombie Apocalypse
tagline: Day 12. The mall is safe. Mostly.
tone: Survival comedy. Scarce food, paranoia about who's been bitten, petty group politics in a barricaded shopping mall.

name: Reality TV Villa
tagline: Eight weeks. One villa. Cameras everywhere.
tone: Trashy dating/competition reality show. Confessionals, alliances, fake-outs, dramatic recouplings, a host who loves chaos.

name: The Office
tone: Workplace mockumentary. Passive-aggressive emails, a doomed team-building retreat, a stolen stapler, a manager who wants to be liked.

name: Fantasy Kingdom
tone: Light-hearted fantasy quest. A vague prophecy, a dragon with opinions, a tavern with a questionable bard, royal intrigue.

name: High School Again
tagline: You're all 16. Prom is in two weeks.
tone: Teen movie. Cliques, a pop quiz nobody studied for, a house party that gets out of hand, prom drama, yearbook superlatives.
